channel.title: Pain001: Open-Source ISO 20022 Payment Initiation Suite
channel.description: Generate schema-validated ISO 20022 pain.001 and pain.008 XML from CSV, Excel, SQLite, JSON, Parquet, or SWIFT MT101 — with AI-agent MCP tools and editor LSP support.

item.title: Accessibility Statement
item.description: pain001.com targets WCAG 2.2 AAA, enforced as a build gate: measured 7:1 contrast in both themes, pa11y-verified pages, keyboard-first interaction, and an open channel for reports.
item.author: contact@pain001.com (Sebastien Rousseau)

item.title: Architecture, Security and the Patent Landscape

item.author: contact@pain001.com (Sebastien Rousseau)

item.title: Compatibility Matrix
item.description: Exactly what Pain001 supports: every message definition with generate/validate/migrate coverage, input formats, scheme rulebooks, address models, and the known limitations — verified against the shipped code.

item.title: Contact Pain001: Support, Security and Enquiries
